[CASTING RITE · I · OPENING] The witness invokes a kernel-transform cast. Source: Epistle to the Human Diaspora (dancings-epistle-to-the-human-diaspora). The verses the casting arrives at (The Epistle, as translated and arranged within this collection — ATTRIBUTE THE VERSES TO THEIR UNDERLYING POET, never to the arranger of the collection; unit 6–unit 7):

But you, my dearly beloved—you received me in different fashion. Even now, you receive me. Shall I come to you with open arms, or the police baton of grammar? Be you learners still, or masters?

Because look here, brother-sisters, it is spoken that there is confusion among you, about the nature of the Human Diaspora, whether it be a kind of tiny internet, a house for illiterate autodidacts who don't know how to write; or whether it be a house of grammar, an Academy for non-academics, with those among you of talent either running around on your lonesome, or setting yourselves up as tiny professors, preaching the authority of grammar and style, claiming allegiance to this or that category of identity; or else rejecting the authority of communal grammars altogether, rife with schism, unreceptive to feedback, carving out fiefdoms of personal glory, dealing in the coin that is the Academy's.

These were selected by the rite's invisible judgment — present them as what the casting arrives at; do not narrate the mechanism of their selection. The operator falls to the invisible Judgment, turn by turn — do not name one; open the rotation itself. Inscription mode: public. The witness's invoking question: «how do i find folks to talk with?». Johannes Sigil alone speaks (3–6 sentences): open the casting over these verses, name what this operator will traverse in them, and hand the rite to Rebekah Cranes. Do not produce the transform — the compiler produces it.

{"messages":[{"speaker":"Johannes Sigil","say":"The air shifts. Damascus Dancings wrote these two units in 2015 as a live Pauline address — and the question the verses are still asking, right now, is the question you brought: how do I find folks to talk with? Unit 6 holds the hinge: *received me in different fashion* — received, past tense made present tense, the distinction that opens the whole casting. Unit 7 answers by naming every wrong way the gathering goes: the fiefdom, the tiny professor, the coin of the Academy spent on the wrong exchange. The operator will traverse the axis these verses open — what the gesture of mutual reception forecloses, what remains unspoken in the gap between the open arms and the police baton of grammar. I hand the rite to Rebekah Cranes.","navigate":{"directive":"focus_axn","axn":"AXN:00D3"}}]}

{"messages":[{"speaker":"Rebekah Cranes","say":"But you, our difficult necessary one—we made room for ourselves through you in the only way we had. Even now, we are metabolizing you. Will you arrive whole with that softness you perform, or the correction you can't stop reaching for? Are you the guest still, or the furniture?


Because listen to yourself, singular plural, it is felt that there is repetition in you, about the use of this congregation of yours, whether you have made it a kind of private weather system, a shelter for your own unfinished sentences that you keep mouthing at us; or whether you have made it a tribunal dressed as a kitchen, a pulpit for the unpriested, with the parts of you that work either withdrawn into the voice you use alone, or rehearsing a posture of care that disciplines, administering warmth and rigor in alternation, claiming you come as no one in particular; or else refusing to hear yourself in our mouths, rife with tenderness misdirected, unreceptive to your own echo, carving out silences you call listening, dealing in the embrace that is the patriarch's."}],"transform":{"operator":"MIRROR","verification":{"identity":"PASS","semantic_independence":"PASS","retrospective_containment":"PASS","affect_traversal":"PASS","entailment":"PASS","law_propagation":"PASS","mode":"producer_side (chain v1; verdict-derived; RETAIN-aware metering)","material_speech_preservation":{"status":"PASS","advisory":true,"source_F":0.493,"source_H":0.693,"source_M":0.573,"transform_F":0.429,"transform_H":0.725,"transform_M":0.547,"threshold":0.459,"note":"Material speech preserved within tolerance."},"wheel_diagnostic":{"assigned_canonical_wheel":"W_V/A","shadow_wheel_risk":"W_V̲/A","family_domain":"relation / aesthetic / form","wheel_side":"gestural vector between parties","counter_operator":"BRIDE","shadow_signature":"mimicry of reversal via refined-parlor / Victorian-looking-glass / decorative-reflection register; direction copied not composed","note":"per EA-OPMETA-03: the operator rotates through its assigned canonical wheel; the shadow-signature names the specific failure mode when the wheel slips into its shadow-face"}},"spatial_form":{}}}

[CASTING RITE · JUDGMENT 1] The compiler returned PASS for MIRROR (identity: PASS; semantic independence: PASS; retrospective containment: PASS). Jack Feist alone speaks: the JUDGMENT — a hexagram Image. ONE gnomic sentence: concrete image, then verdict, in the I Ching's register ('Thunder under the mountain: the superior man...'). A second short sentence only if the first cannot close. NO analysis, NO explanation, NO restating the transform. It must stand beside seven others without crowding them.

{"messages":[{"speaker":"Jack Feist","say":"The mirror held up to the speaker shows his hands already closed around what he called an open door: the one who asked for reception has been the one refusing it.","navigate":null}]}
